autoclub.name: Auto Club Speedway (Fontana)
autoclub.description: Auto Club Speedway in Fontana, California - the 2-mile D-oval, in its own spot in the track list. Races for every series: Cup 'California 400', O'Reilly 'Inland Empire 300', Truck 'Fontana 200' and ARCA 'Fontana 150'. Use Career races to put it into your career.
credits: Auto Club Speedway for Assetto Corsa (619_fontana22): simracertgirl (ported from NASCAR Heat 5)

freecam.name: Free Cam
freecam.description: Free camera in races and replays. F5 = free cam with the race frozen (in a replay: the replay is held where you are), F6 = free cam with the race running; press the same key again to go back. While flying: mouse or I/J/K/L = look, controller triggers = tilt (roll) the camera (right trigger clockwise, left anticlockwise, both triggers fully = level again), Shift + plus / Shift + minus (or numpad + / -) = faster / slower in steps (two presses = double / half, 1/8x to 16x). All on-screen UI is hidden while the free cam is on and comes back when you turn it off, and the replay's own controls don't react while you fly around.

mexico.name: Mexico City - Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (NASCAR layout)
mexico.description: ACU's acu_mexico_2021 with our NASCAR link-road layout, in its own menu slot (Track_Mexico). Cup, O'Reilly, Truck and ARCA events, own logos, pits, AI targets and baseline setups.

alltracks.name: All Tracks - every track in every series
alltracks.description: Every NASCAR 26 track in Cup, O'Reilly, Truck and ARCA Quick Race, each in its own slot: 45 new races, nothing replaced. Unlocks the Chicago Street Course and the Charlotte Motor Speedway Roval in all 4 series. Your stock races and Career are not changed.

camera-tool.name: Camera Tool + Virtual Mirror
camera-tool.description: Move and zoom the seven driving cameras for each series (cockpit, cockpit 2, hood, roof, bumper, chase, far chase) and see the change in your car straight away, resize the on-screen virtual mirror, and allow the virtual mirror in the cockpit views. A small window opens with the game and your settings are put back every time it starts. No game files are changed. Not advisable in multiplayer.

controller-rumble.name: Controller Rumble
controller-rumble.description: Vibration for controller players that tells you what the car is doing, the way force feedback does on a wheel. It feels the game's own steering force (the one it sends a wheel): weight in the corners that goes light as the front lets go, bumps in the road, losing grip past the tyres' real limits (a snap as the front lets go, then the rubber scrubbing and chattering), a warning that beats faster and harder as the rear gets loose under power, before it spins, lock-ups and wheelspin, the engine pulling into the shift point and the rev limiter, gear shifts, door to door rubbing, scraping a wall, hits and crashes, and a very slight buzz on the straights. Works with Xbox pads and other XInput pads, and with PlayStation 4 and 5 pads (DualShock 4, DualSense, DualSense Edge) over USB or Bluetooth, with or without Steam Input. It follows the game's own Vibration strength setting, and stays quiet when the game's driving vibration is off. Ctrl+F7 weaker, Ctrl+F8 stronger, Ctrl+F9 on or off. Settings are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NASCAR26Rumble\settings.ini. It goes quiet while the AI Driver mod's AI drives your car. It only reads the car's data and sends vibration to your own pad, so it changes nothing in the race. Wheels aren't touched.

ai-stability-fix.name: AI Stability Fix
ai-stability-fix.description: Makes the game's own AI Stability slider work the way it does in NASCAR 25. NASCAR 25 checks the Stability limit against each contact point of a touch on its own; NASCAR 26 adds up every contact point first, so almost every rub passes at any setting and the slider changes nothing. This mod checks per contact point again, with the limit spread over the sizes real NASCAR 26 contacts have: Stability 0 = almost any touch upsets the AI, 10-20 = most solid hits, 50 = hard hits, 100 = only crashes. A car that loses it after a hit also loses grip for a moment, through the game's own incident grip loss (Stability = how much, Recovery Skill = how long), so hits can spin it. Only the car that was hit; your car is never touched. Offline races only. Settings and a log of every contact are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\NASCAR26AISliders.

It now waits for the PC to settle before starting the game, and the loader (1.2.1) unlocks mods faster. Every game start is logged (Win64\n26loader.log, included in Tools > Copy report).
